```c
 9: 
10:     /* Constant-time comparison: returns 0 only if all bytes match. */
11:     if (ct_memcmp(expected, ct->c3.data, SM3_DIGEST_LEN) != 0)
12:         return false;
13: 
14:     return true;
15: }
```

If ct->c3 length < 32, then reading ct->c3.data beyond length -> out of bounds read. Also if longer, only first 32 compared.

Bug is introduced at line 11? Or at assumption? The comparison uses SM3_DIGEST_LEN without checking ct->c3 length. Primary bug is line 11. Could also be line 12? No.

Maybe also need to check length before compare. So bug line 11.

If bug is only clear from small group adjacent lines, maybe 11,12? The comparison is line 11.

Answer: 11
